name: Trans Sumatra
definition: Toll backbone built by Hutama Karya (JTTS), Lampung to Aceh
notes: The 13 curated sections total 1,667.31 km, or 58% of the 2,854 km plan; the segment table is partial. About 1,161 km built, of which 982 km operational. Bina Marga reports 1,051.84 km Phase I operational (Aug 2026); the figures differ by scope and date.

name: Trans Java
definition: BPJT toll network from Merak to Banyuwangi, including the MBZ elevated section and the Gempol–Pandaan branch
notes: Composite series: 1,056.38 km across 20 sections operating by January 2025 plus 23.515 km Gending–Paiton operational on 7 September 2026. 176.42 km remains: Paiton–Besuki 26.185 km and Besuki–Banyuwangi 126.72 km. The January 2025 article prints a 1,232.78 km total. Older PU and Wikipedia figures of 1,167 km, and a July 2024 Kontan figure of 1,065.50 km operating, use different scopes and dates.

name: Trans Sulawesi
definition: National road (Lintas Sulawesi) from Manado to Makassar
notes: idwiki gives 2,000 km for Manado–Makassar and calls the route 'Selesai sebagian' (partly complete). The 3,900 km figure refers to the wider Sulawesi road network, a different scope. No current operational-km series was found, so the atlas publishes the route total only.

name: Trans Kalimantan
definition: Southern national route (Jalan Lintas Kalimantan Poros Selatan) from Aruk, Sambas to Malinau
metric: route length; no current progress series
notes: 3,901 km Aruk–Malinau. The article says the route was completed in 2016, but the Penajam–Balikpapan ferry crossing remains and no current operational-km series was found. Competing definitions: 1,186 km travel route, 1,920 km border-parallel road and 2,100.8 km WPS figure.

name: Trans Papua
definition: National road corridor from Sorong to Merauke
notes: 3,446 km connected; 2,235 km paved and 1,132 km still soil as of November 2025. About 50 km remains on Jayapura-Wamena (December 2025). The segment table covers the eight Papua-side segments only (2,345.40 km); the four West Papua and Southwest Papua segments have no published lengths.
